tools.name: faf
tools.description: Type "faf" to start. Scores your project, drives it to 100%, syncs everything. The one command that does it all.

path.description: Project path (optional — uses current directory if not provided)

tools.name: faf_about
tools.description: Explain what the FAF format is — project DNA for AI — with its IANA registration, version, and connected platforms. Returns format metadata and the available MCP bridges. Use this when someone asks what FAF is or how it connects to other AI tools.

tools.name: faf_status
tools.description: Check if your project has project.faf (project DNA for AI) - Shows AI-readability status

path.description: Project path. Sets session context for subsequent calls.

tools.name: faf_score
tools.description: Score a project.faf and return its 0–100% AI-readability, tier, and per-slot breakdown, via the deterministic Mk4 engine. Use this for a quick status check; use faf_doctor when you need to diagnose and fix what's missing.

details.description: Include detailed breakdown and improvement suggestions

path.description: Project path. Sets session context for subsequent calls.

tools.name: faf_init
tools.description: Create a new project.faf with a name, goal, and language. Returns the file path and starting score. Won't overwrite an existing file — use faf_auto to fill the stack from your manifests, or faf_go for the human 6Ws.

path.description: Project path or name. Smart resolution: "my-app" finds ~/Projects/my-app OR ~/Code/my-app. Full paths like ~/Projects/app or /Users/me/code/app work too. Omit to create ~/Projects/unnamed-project; pass the workspace path to init it.

force.description: Overwrite existing project.faf if it exists

tools.name: faf_trust
tools.description: Attest a project.faf's integrity: its validity, score, and a deterministic parity hash any conformant engine reproduces. Returns the ✪ receipt. Use this to prove a score is genuine and untampered.

path.description: Project path. Sets session context for subsequent calls.

tools.name: faf_setup
tools.description: Install the native SessionStart hook — every Claude Code session in this project starts with fresh .faf context. Shows the exact settings JSON first (preview); writes only with confirm: true. Non-destructive: existing settings and hooks are preserved. remove: true uninstalls exactly the faf hook.

path.description: Project path. Defaults to the current project context.

confirm.description: Actually write the hook into .claude/settings.json. Without it, faf_setup only previews.

remove.description: Remove the faf SessionStart hook (and only it) from .claude/settings.json.

tools.name: faf_sync
tools.description: Sync project.faf into CLAUDE.md as a faf-managed block, and optionally into AGENTS.md (agents), .cursorrules (cursor), GEMINI.md (gemini), and .github/copilot-instructions.md (copilot) — or all of them (all). Updates each block in place — it never overwrites your file. Use this after editing project.faf so every AI tool sees the latest context.

gemini.description: Also sync to GEMINI.md (Google Gemini format)

all.description: Sync to ALL formats: CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md + .cursorrules + GEMINI.md + .github/copilot-instructions.md

path.description: Project path. Sets session context for subsequent calls.

tools.name: faf_clear
tools.description: Clear caches, temporary files, and reset FAF state for a fresh start

tools.name: faf_debug
tools.description: Debug Claude FAF MCP environment - show working directory, permissions, and FAF CLI status

tools.name: faf_read
tools.description: Read a file within the project root (cwd / FAF_ALLOWED_ROOTS). Paths that escape the project are refused.

path.description: Absolute or relative file path to read

tools.name: faf_write
tools.description: Write a file within the project root (cwd / FAF_ALLOWED_ROOTS). Paths that escape the project are refused.

path.description: Absolute or relative file path to write

content.description: Content to write to the file

tools.name: faf_list
tools.description: List directories and discover projects with project.faf files - Essential for FAF discovery workflow

path.description: Directory path to list (e.g., ~/Projects, /Users/username/Projects)

filter.description: Filter: "faf" (only dirs with project.faf), "dirs" (all directories), "all" (dirs and files). Default: "dirs"

depth.description: Directory depth to scan: 1 (immediate children) or 2 (one level deeper). Default: 1

showHidden.description: Show hidden files/directories (starting with .). Default: false

tools.name: faf_friday
tools.description: Detect the FAF Chrome extension and run fuzzy-matching helpers.

test.description: Test fuzzy matching with typos like "raect" or "chr ext"

tools.name: faf_guide
tools.description: FAF MCP usage guide for Claude Desktop - Projects convention, path resolution, and UX patterns

tools.name: faf_readme
tools.description: Extract 6 Ws (Who/What/Why/Where/When/How) from README.md into human_context - Smart pattern matching

apply.description: Apply extracted content to project.faf (default: preview only)

force.description: Overwrite existing human_context values (default: only fill empty slots)

path.description: Project path. Sets session context for subsequent calls.

tools.name: faf_human_add
tools.description: Add a human_context field (who/what/why/where/when/how) - Non-interactive for MCP

value.description: The value to set for the field

path.description: Project path. Sets session context for subsequent calls.

tools.name: faf_check
tools.description: Quality inspection for human_context fields + field protection - Shows empty/generic/good/excellent ratings

protect.description: Lock good/excellent fields from being overwritten

path.description: Project path. Sets session context for subsequent calls.

tools.name: faf_context
tools.description: Set or show the active project path that subsequent faf_ calls resolve against. Returns the current context path. Call this once at the start of a session so the other tools target the right project.

path.description: Set active project path. If omitted, shows current context.

tools.name: faf_go
tools.description: The friendly front door — "let's go, tell me about your idea." Asks the human the 6Ws (goal, why, who, what, where, when) that can't be auto-detected, then applies them to project.faf. If no project.faf exists yet, faf_go bootstraps it first (creates it, sources the stack) so you go from nothing to the 6Ws in one step. Returns the Table-of-8 to confirm/answer, or applies the answers you pass back. Use faf_auto for the technical stack on its own.

path.description: Project path. Sets session context for subsequent calls.

answers.description: Answers to apply. Keys are field paths (e.g., "project.goal", "human_context.why"), values are the answers. If provided, applies answers and returns new score.

tools.name: faf_auto
tools.description: Scan your manifests (package.json, Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, go.mod…) and fill the project.faf stack slots from real dependencies — no hardcoded defaults. Returns what was detected and the updated score. Use this for the technical context; use faf_go for the human 6Ws it can't detect. Also writes CLAUDE.md's faf-managed block from the result.

path.description: Project path. Sets session context for subsequent calls.

tools.name: faf_bench
tools.description: Prove the .faf earns its place — measure how much the context is worth, on THIS repo, falsifiably. Questions derive from the project.faf's own populated slots (the .faf is the answer key), so grading is mechanical — no judge, no rubric. action=questions returns the answer-key-safe question set; action=grade takes your answers WITHOUT the .faf (cold) and WITH it (faf), grades both, and returns the cold→with-faf lift with a ✪ receipt. The delta is the product; the cold number belongs to the absence of context, never to FAF.

path.description: Project path (optional — current directory if omitted).

action.description: questions = get the answer-key-safe question set to answer; grade = submit cold + with-faf answers to score the delta. Default: questions.

cold.description: action=grade: answers produced WITHOUT the .faf (general repo knowledge only). Map of question number → answer string.

faf.description: action=grade: answers produced WITH the project.faf in context. Map of question number → answer string.

fafTokens.description: action=grade (optional): tokens spent answering with the .faf.

model.description: action=grade (optional): the model that produced the answers.

tools.name: faf_dna
tools.description: Show the project FAF DNA — score history and progression over time.

path.description: Project path. Sets session context for subsequent calls.

tools.name: faf_formats
tools.description: Discover all formats in the project (154+ validated types) and fill stack slots.

path.description: Project path. Sets session context for subsequent calls.

tools.name: faf_quick
tools.description: Lightning-fast .faf creation - One-liner format: "name, description, language, framework, hosting"

path.description: Project path. Sets session context for subsequent calls.

input.description: Quick input: "project-name, description, language, framework, hosting" (minimum: name, description)

tools.name: faf_doctor
tools.description: Diagnose a project.faf: report empty or weak slots, common issues, and how to fix each. Returns a prioritized checklist. Use this when faf_score is below target and you need to know why.

path.description: Project path. Sets session context for subsequent calls.

action.description: export = sync .faf to MEMORY.md, status = show MEMORY.md state

path.description: Project path. Sets session context for subsequent calls.

tools.name: faf_etch
tools.description: Remember a decision, gotcha, or win across sessions by writing it to the project soul (.fafm). Returns the stored memory's id. Use this to persist something an AI should recall later; use faf_recall to read them back.

text.description: The memory to remember — capture the why (decision/gotcha/win)

id.description: Stable id — re-etching the same id updates in place (dedup)

priority.description: Recall ranks by priority then recency

tags.description: Tags (e.g. decision, gotcha, win) for filtering + recall coupling

path.description: Project path. Sets session context for subsequent calls.

tools.name: faf_recall
tools.description: Recall memories from the project soul (.fafm), ranked by priority then recency, filtered by query/tags/type. Returns the matching entries. Use this to surface past decisions; use faf_etch to add new ones.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring match on memory text (optional)

path.description: Project path. Sets session context for subsequent calls.
